text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGE: production - elevated 5xx rate in eu-west during blue->green traffic shift. AlertID: PROD-EU-5XX-182345. auto-escalate to oncall

sam: got it, i'm oncall. pinging infra and SRE. @maria are you able to take the lead?

maria: taking lead. on VPN. quick ask: is this the canary traffic shift started ~12:10UTC?

pagerbot: canary-rollout job started at 1823456600. target=green, rollout=20% global, eu-west weight=50% per rollout policy.

lee: seeing 5xx spikes from frontend->model-proxy in eu-west. error=502 / 504 at 12:12-12:16UTC. other regions fine.

maria: checking control plane. model variant green appears healthy in region but upstream cache misses causing backend overload. metrics: eu-west 5xx rate=14.7%, p95 latency doubled.

rachel: any customer reports yet? CX said one customer support ticket about timeouts in EU.

maria: adding mitigation checklist: 1) kill-switch feature-flag to stop shift 2) rollback weights to blue 3) flush edge routing if mismatch 4) add traffic-only to stable pool.

sam: try kill-switch first. give me the feature-flag toggle command.

maria: run this from infra jump:
```
# toggle rollout kill-switch
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/canary-rollout/override \
  -d '{"state":"off","scope":"eu-west"}'
```

lee: i ran the toggle, API returned 200, flag state=off, but metrics unchanged in last 30s. possibly routing cached at edge.

maria: ugh. looks like frontend edge config still sends 50% to green via CDN region table. CDN sync shows stale table for eu-west POPs. TTLs haven't expired yet.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-9482. Pager duty oncall updated. Runbook: /runbooks/rollout-fail.

sam: ok we need immediate traffic steering at the load-balancer layer. Maria / Lee, can you apply a direct LB override to pin eu-west to blue?

maria: applying override now — using envoy-control to set route weight to blue=100 for cluster=prod-eu.
```
# envoy-control override
rbacctl route-override --cluster prod-eu --route /api --weights blue=1,green=0 --reason "rollback-after-canary-5xx"
```

lee: override accepted, pushing to edge-proxy fleet. monitoring...

lee: metrics update: eu-west 5xx dropped from 14.7% -> 2.3% in 60s. latency trending down. looks like LB override fixed the immediate user impact.

rachel: good. customers still impacted briefly; CX notified. want a short status paragraph for customer comms?

sam: yes — put draft below.

rachel: "We briefly shifted a portion of EU traffic to a new model variant which caused elevated errors and timeouts for some customers. We reverted the traffic routing and have restored normal service. Our team is investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem."

maria: root cause hypothesis: mismatch between feature-flag control plane and edge routing table (CDN POP TTLs) during phased rollout. the control plane stopped rollout but edge had long TTLs so some POPs continued sending traffic to green. That overflowed upstreams leading to 5xx.

sam: action items now: 1) keep LB override until CDN TTLs cleared (ETA 10m) 2) disable canary job and mark rollout aborted 3) collect logs and traces for incidents ticket 4) schedule postmortem.

lee: i've exported traces and proxy logs to INC-2026-9482/snapshots. also collected edge CDN sync status.

maria: disabled canary job in CI: `ci rollback cancel-rollout --job canary-rollout-182345` and set feature-flag permanently off for safety.

ops-bot: Pager cleared for PROD-EU-5XX-182345 (ack by sam at 1823457020).

sam: thanks everyone — leaving LB override in place until midnight UTC to be safe, will handoff to night oncall @lee. Lee, please monitor for 2 hours and ping if regression.

lee: ack, taking handoff. i'll run extra synthetic checks and watch error budget for eu-west. setting calendar handoff note.

rachel: flagged priority customers and created a customer comms thread. will coordinate PM follow up.

maria: adding checklist to the ticket for postmortem: CDN TTL strategy, feature-flag->edge sync, canary rollout gating, runtime backpressure handling.

sam: thanks team. Postmortem owner: @maria. Incident state: mitigated, monitoring.

oncall-bot: Handoff logged to night oncall lee. Incident INC-2026-9482 assigned to maria (owner) and lee (monitoring).

sam: closing slack thread, will update when postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
